segments.name: Gyre Pharmaceuticals
segments.description: Develops and commercializes small-molecule therapies for organ fibrosis and inflammatory diseases in the PRC.
segments.evidence: Gyre Pharmaceuticals has three major commercial drug products, ETUARY®, Etorel®, and Contiva®—as well as several product candidates in preclinical and clinical development.

segments.name: Gyre
segments.description: Biopharmaceutical company focused on development and commercialization of Hydronidone for metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis liver fibrosis in the United States.
segments.evidence: Gyre is a biopharmaceutical company focused on the development and commercialization of Hydronidone for the treatment of metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis ("MASH")-associated liver fibrosis in the United States.

revenueModel.text: Gyre Pharmaceuticals sells pharmaceutical products to distributors in mainland China, who ultimately sell to hospitals, other medical institutions and pharmacies.
